title: When You Can't Just Walk Away: Setting Boundaries with Co-Parents
coreMove: Structured co-parenting contact protects children by moving conflict into rules: written channels, handoff limits, schedule terms, documented decisions, and no adult drama at the curb.

exampleSpecs.stakes: keep the child from standing inside adult conflict
